issues.message: Offline mode implementation is complex and may require additional time beyond the 32 hours estimated. Consider phased approach with core features first.
Requirements specify UPC, EAN-13, and Code 128, but retail environments may encounter additional formats. Consider extensibility.
Non-functional requirement specifies 5 concurrent users, but testing plan should explicitly include load testing scenarios to validate this.

recommendations: Implement feature flags to enable gradual rollout of complex features like offline mode
Consider using established barcode scanning libraries (e.g., ZXing, QuaggaJS) to reduce development risk
Add database indexes on frequently queried fields (barcode, product_name, transaction_date) for performance
Implement caching strategy for product lookups to improve barcode scan response time
Create automated backup procedures to meet the daily backup non-functional requirement
Develop a comprehensive test data set with realistic product catalog for performance testing
Consider implementing optimistic locking for inventory updates to handle concurrent transactions
Add monitoring and alerting for system health and performance metrics
Create a rollback plan for production deployment
Implement rate limiting on API endpoints to prevent abuse
Consider adding a demo mode for training purposes without affecting production data
